newsitem.title: USA: Toro backs Q3 EPS estimates in $0.70-$0.80 range.
newsitem.headline: Toro backs Q3 EPS estimates in $0.70-$0.80 range.

text.p: Toro Co is comfortable with analysts' estimates for third-quarter earnings in a range of $0.70 to $0.80 per share, said company spokesman Don St. Dennison on Tuesday.
"The estimates we're comfortable with are $0.70 to $0.80 per share for the third quarter and $0.60 to $0.70 per share for the fourth quarter," St. Dennis said in an interview.
He said the company is comfortable with estimates for fiscal 1997 earnings of $3.00 to $3.15 per share.
The lawnmower manufacturer announced Tuesday that weather shortened its spring and summer selling seasons, resulting in earnings estimates differing from analysts' projections.
Shares in Toro were off 3/16 at 36-1/4 in light, early trading Tuesday on the New York Stock Exchange.
